title: Walsh characters multiply by symmetric difference
statement:
Fix $n$, and for a subset $S\subseteq[n]$ let $\chi_S\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ denote the associated Walsh--Fourier character. Then for all subsets $S,T\subseteq[n]$ and every point $x\in\{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \chi_S(x)\,\chi_T(x) \;=\; \chi_{S\,\triangle\,T}(x),
\]
where $S\,\triangle\,T$ is the symmetric difference of $S$ and $T$.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary point x of the Boolean hypercube {0,1}^n
